problems.explain: The marked sides are equal: 8x − 18 = 2x + 18. Take 2x from both sides: 6x − 18 = 18; add 18: 6x = 36; divide by 6: x = 6. Then CA = 8(6) − 18 = 30. (AB = 47 is the base, which need not match the other two.) So CA = 30.
